input.prompt: Prop design sheet for an adventure video game, without any text labels: the mask and the cane of a retro-futuristic plague doctor from an alternate 1990s, where cheap corporate technology is bolted onto old things. The mask: an old dark leather plague doctor beak mask with round brass goggles; the left goggle is replaced by the lens of a grey plastic 1990s camcorder, with a small red recording light next to it; the camcorder module is strapped to the side of the head and its cables run to a battery pack at the back; the beak holds a metal breathing filter cartridge with vents; the glass of the right goggle is scratched, with a faint green screen reflection; a small worn white corporate sticker that reads PANACEA; repairs with grey tape and rivets. Show the mask from the front, in three-quarter view, from the side, and a close-up of the camcorder eye with the red light on. Next to it the cane: a long black walking stick whose tip is a metal sensor probe with a tiny light, connected to the handle by a coiled cable. Neutral grey background, soft studio light, realistic photo with subtle ink line accents like an underground comic. No people.
